name: print-social-creative-business-agency-story-sticker-collage-yellow-fabric
title: 'Creative Business Agency' story mockup: a black sticker-collage flyer laid on wrinkled yellow fabric
whatItIs: A vertical black flyer with a sticker-collage of mismatched fonts and shapes ('CREATIVE', 'BUSINES', 'AGENCY' in a blue box), an eye icon, a numbered services list, sticky-note style tags ('Our Services', 'Your Place'), and 'BOOK NOW', all photographed lying on crumpled yellow fabric.
whatItMeans: Playful and tactile; deliberately clashing type and a real fabric photo mockup give a corporate flyer street-poster energy.
techniques: Mix multiple unrelated typefaces and colours as a deliberate sticker style.
Photograph the final design on a textured real surface for presentation.
Tag key info as if stuck on with individual sticky notes.

vocabulary.definition: A layout mimicking overlapping stuck-on stickers of mixed styles.
A design photographed on real cloth for a tactile presentation.
